# Contributing to PBIR Visual Manager

Thanks for your interest in contributing!

## Development Setup

1. Clone the repository
2. Open `index.html` in Chrome, Edge, or Opera (requires File System Access API)
3. No build tools or dependencies required -- it runs directly in the browser

## Reporting Issues

- Search [existing issues](https://github.com/JonathanJihwanKim/isHiddenInViewMode/issues) before opening a new one
- Include your browser name/version and steps to reproduce the problem
- Attach screenshots if the issue is visual

## Pull Requests

1. Fork the repo and create a feature branch from `main`
2. Keep changes focused -- one feature or fix per PR
3. Test with a real PBIR report folder before submitting
4. Describe what your PR does and why

## Code Style

- Use 4-space indentation
- Follow the existing naming conventions and file structure
- Keep the app as a single-page application with no build step
- Prefer vanilla JavaScript -- no frameworks or external runtime dependencies
